detail.longDescription: To start debugging a Rust program in an environment where only rustc is present, I need to complete the install, as I received this message when starting my RustRover IDE: RustRover needs the Rust standard library source code for code insight, but it was not found at /usr/local/lib/rustlib/src/rust to fix this, copy the standard library source code to: /usr/local/lib/rustlib/src/rust I've downloaded the rust-lang/rust tag 1.95.0 version (the one of my rustc ) into a zip and sent it to my offline computer. Then, I've attempted to copy the inner directories of rust-lang/rust/tree/1.95.0/src to /usr/local/lib/rustlib/src/rust , but they weren't the good ones: at IDE restart, they weren't recognized. What folders among this Rust GitHub version should I copy? It's neither strictly those of rust-lang/rust/tree/1.95.0/library/std/src . And/or is there something else I should do? How to provide standard library sources for IntelliJ IDEA's Rust project? uses apt install rust-src package or rustup command, both not working in my offilne environment.
